explanationTemplates.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: Claim supported by {{supportingCount}} evidence items from {{sourceCount}} unique domain(s) with an average source authenticity score of {{avgAuthenticity}}%.
explanationTemplates.CLAIM_CONTRADICTED: Claim contradicted by {{contradictingCount}} evidence item(s) from higher-authority sources (Average authenticity: {{avgAuthenticity}}%).
explanationTemplates.CLAIM_PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: Claim partially supported by {{supportingCount}} evidence item(s) with partial semantic alignment and {{contradictingCount}} conflicting snippet(s).
explanationTemplates.CLAIM_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Insufficient evidence to verify claim statement. Only {{supportingCount}} evidence item(s) retrieved meeting quality thresholds.
explanationTemplates.CLAIM_UNVERIFIABLE: Claim statement is unverifiable due to missing domain sources or broken provenance chains.
explanationTemplates.PENALTY_SINGLE_SOURCE: Confidence score reduced by {{penaltyPoints}} points due to single source domain dependency (Domain: {{domain}}).
explanationTemplates.PENALTY_LOW_AUTHENTICITY: Confidence score reduced by {{penaltyPoints}} points due to low average source domain authenticity score ({{avgAuthenticity}}%).
explanationTemplates.PENALTY_CONTRADICTION: Confidence score reduced by {{penaltyPoints}} points due to presence of contradictory evidence snippets.
explanationTemplates.PENALTY_INCOMPLETE_LINEAGE: Confidence score reduced by {{penaltyPoints}} points due to partial or broken evidence lineage graph nodes.
explanationTemplates.PENALTY_LOW_RELEVANCE: Confidence score reduced by {{penaltyPoints}} points due to low semantic vector relevance scores across evidence items.

verdictSummaries.FULLY_SUPPORTED: All claims extracted from the research query are fully supported by high-authority evidence and complete provenance lineage.
verdictSummaries.PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: The majority of extracted claims are supported, though some claims exhibit partial alignment or minor evidence gaps.
verdictSummaries.CONTRADICTED: One or more core claims are directly contradicted by verified high-authority domain sources.
verdictSummaries.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: The retrieved evidence is insufficient to conclusively support or contradict the research query claims.
verdictSummaries.MIXED_EVIDENCE: The pipeline identified conflicting evidence across multiple independent sources.
